Frontend Architecture Notice

You are exploring NOVA — Living Intelligence, a premium 3D AI workspace frontend.

Core Features & Architecture:

  • Signature 3D Sculpture: Three interwoven, twisted titanium ribbons with illuminated cyan/violet inner edges surrounding a pearl-white luminous crystal.
  • 45% / 55% Editorial Workspace: Generous conversation studio with anchored composer and empty state starter pathways.
  • Browser Speech Engine: Web Speech API speech recognition and voice synthesis with manual stop controls.
  • Website Studio: Sandboxed showcase featuring the curated luxury dining template with responsive simulation.
  • Local Persistence: Full conversation history stored in localStorage with search and export.

Connecting to Node.js/Express:

Responses are currently generated locally by src/services/apiAdapter.js. Set isDemoMode = false and point to your POST /api/chat endpoint to connect a real backend.
